Key Details & Background
Worldwide Release: November 5, 2026 (strategically timed for the Diwali festival window).
Run Time: Around 2 hours and 45 minutes to 3 hours 15 minutes, offering an operatic, fast-paced narrative that moves efficiently through the expansive mythological storyline.

Ranbir Kapoor as Prince Rama

Uma garota no trem decide aplicar uma vingança inusitada contra quem invadiu seu espaço com cócegas nos pés.

Tudo começou quando um passageiro colocou os pés do lado errado da janela. Para lidar com a situação, ela elaborou uma estratégia curiosa de vingança, simulando uma reação engraçada ao fazer cócegas nos próprios pés. É um momento de humor que mostra como pequenas atitudes no transporte público podem gerar situações cômicas.

Além de demonstrar como seria o comportamento de alguém que sofre com cócegas, ela ilustra de forma bem-humorada como reagir a situações desconfortáveis. A brincadeira serve como um exemplo de como transformar um incômodo passageiro em um exercício de criatividade e diversão entre os passageiros de um trem.

Inscreva-se para ver mais vídeos de situações inusitadas e conte aqui nos comentários: você teria coragem de reagir dessa forma se alguém invadisse seu espaço?

- Oil तेल

- Onion प्याज़

* Fry paneer in oil until golden brown. पनीर को तेल में सुनहरा होने तक तल लें।

candidates.description:
Ranbir Kapoor’s Ramayana, released on November 5, is making headlines for the extraordinary preparation behind its visuals. Two production details have emerged: Ravana’s throne was finished with real 24-carat gold leafing, while the Ravana–Jatayu battle took six and a half years to develop, according to the filmmakers.

Art director Ramesh revealed that the throne used by Yash’s Ravana took approximately four months to construct and cost around ₹1 crore. Artisans first created a clay model, prepared a mould and built the structure using fibre before applying the gold finish. Gold leafing uses extremely thin sheets of real gold over another material; the throne itself was not solid gold. 

Director Nitesh Tiwari separately explained that the Jatayu battle’s lengthy timeline covered the journey from the initial artist briefing to the finished sequence. It represents years of conceptualisation, design changes and visual-effects work, rather than six years of continuous filming. Thousands of people contributed to bringing the sequence to the screen.

A major challenge involved designing the Pushpak Viman. The team explored roughly 40–50 designs and spent close to two years settling on its appearance. Changes to the flying vehicle subsequently required revisions to the aerial confrontation between Ravana and Jatayu.

Ranbir also highlighted the effort of visual-effects artists, expressing disappointment when their work is casually dismissed as AI-generated. Together, these accounts offer Indian audiences a clearer picture of the physical craftsmanship and digital production behind the film’s ambitious retelling of the epic.

An incredible wildlife rescue unfolded in Ohio when Stephen Baldridge, his brother Josh Baldridge, and a third man came across a deer trapped in a frightening situation.

The animal's antlers had become entangled in a rope attached to a tree, leaving the deer partially suspended and struggling desperately to break free.

Footage recorded by Stephen shows the distressed deer jumping and swinging back and forth as it attempts to escape.

According to Stephen, the men initially couldn't believe what they were seeing when they spotted the deer swinging in the air.

Realizing the animal needed help, the three men quickly stepped in to figure out how to free it safely.

Josh patiently waited for the right moment to grab and restrain the struggling deer so they could release it from the rope.

Despite the animal's frantic movements, the rescuers managed to intervene and free the deer from its dangerous predicament.

In a heartwarming moment, the deer finally escaped and ran off to freedom!

Stephen later explained that his brother believed helping the trapped animal was simply the right thing to do.

What began as a frightening situation turned into an unforgettable act of kindness, thanks to three men who refused to leave a helpless animal behind.

A teenager stands in a kitchen, nerves barely masked by determination.

He’s been told he’s too young, inexperienced, not fit for the task.

Yet, with hesitant hands, he offers a taste of his homemade lemon meringue.

To everyone's surprise, it’s not just edible—it’s impressive.

This isn’t just about baking.

It’s a quiet rebellion against being underestimated.

A claim to identity in a world that tries to define him by age or background.

👉 True passion can shine, even without formal approval.

👉 Talent often emerges in the moments nobody expects.

👉 Believing in yourself is the first step to making others believe in you.

The uncomfortable truth?

Many get dismissed not because they lack skill, but because others refuse to see their potential.

Judgment often blinds us to hidden abilities and untold stories.

So the real question is:

How might our lives change if we gave people more space to prove themselves before doubting? 👇💬

candidates.creator: International Parenting Health Institute
candidates.title: Sometimes, the safest place in a child's world is their brother's arms. 🥹❤
candidates.description:
Watch this little boy as he seeks comfort in his older brother’s arms.

There’s something incredibly touching about the way he leans into him, and the way his brother wraps his arms around him.

No elaborate explanation. No attempt to make the feelings disappear. Just closeness.

And sometimes, that connection is exactly what a child is looking for.

Sibling relationships are among the earliest and most influential relationships children experience.

While parents and caregivers play a foundational role in emotional development, siblings can also become important sources of comfort, reassurance, companionship, and belonging.

Through everyday interactions, children have opportunities to develop empathy, emotional awareness, communication skills, and the ability to recognize and respond to another person’s feelings.

These experiences can also support the development of co-regulation.

Co-regulation happens when one person’s calm, responsive presence helps another person navigate an emotional experience.

It doesn’t always require words.

Sometimes, it’s a hug.
Sometimes, it’s sitting together.
Sometimes, it’s simply knowing someone is there.

And while sibling relationships naturally include disagreements, frustration, competition, and conflict, they can also offer meaningful opportunities to practice empathy, cooperation, emotional repair, and connection.

What’s especially beautiful about moments like this is that they remind us that children aren’t only learning how to receive comfort.

They’re also learning how to offer it.

And those small, everyday experiences of being seen, supported, and understood can contribute to the emotional foundations children carry into future relationships.

At the International Parenting & Health Institute (IPHI), we encourage families to recognize and nurture these meaningful connections without expecting siblings to take responsibility for one another’s emotional well-being.

A gentle side note: This post celebrates sibling connection, not screen habits or parenting choices. A brief video never tells the whole story of a family’s day.

Because sometimes, one small hug reminds us just how powerful human connection can be.

candidates.description:
The Mirage is a family of jet aircraft designed by the French aerospace company Dassault Aviation. Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. The Mirage 2000, for instance, introduced fly-by-wire technology and advanced radar systems, making it a formidable multi-role fighter capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. The Mirage legacy continues to be celebrated for its contribution to both military aviation and aeronautical engineering.

candidates.creator: A vida é uma maravilha
candidates.title: O homem que pulou de avião sem paraquedas 🪂
candidates.description:
O salto do Luke Aikins aconteceu em 30 de julho de 2016, no Big Sky Movie Ranch, em Simi Valley, na Califórnia. O evento se chamou "Heaven Sent" e foi transmitido ao vivo pela TV americana Fox. Os 7.600 metros equivalem a 25 mil pés, mais ou menos a altura em que voa um avião comercial pouco depois de decolar. 🪂

O Luke não era nenhum novato. Ele é de uma família de paraquedistas, a terceira geração, e já tinha mais de 18 mil saltos quando fez o desafio. Também foi coordenador de cenas aéreas em Hollywood, como no filme Homem de Ferro 3, e ajudou a treinar o austríaco Felix Baumgartner pro famoso salto da estratosfera da Red Bull, em 2012. 🎬

A preparação levou cerca de dois anos. A rede foi montada entre quatro guindastes, mais ou menos na altura de um prédio de 20 andares, e no começo do salto ele usou uma máscara de oxigênio, porque o ar a essa altitude é rarefeito demais. Num ponto da queda, ele entregou o cilindro de oxigênio pra um dos colegas que pulavam junto. 🏗️

Até poucas horas antes do salto, ele ainda estava escalado pra pular com paraquedas nas costas. O sindicato de atores dos Estados Unidos exigia o equipamento por causa da transmissão ao vivo, e o Luke chegou a dizer que, se fosse assim, desistia do desafio. A exigência foi retirada pouco antes da decolagem. 📺

Os quase 200 km/h que ele atingiu correspondem à chamada velocidade terminal. Ela acontece quando a resistência do ar fica igual à força da gravidade, e a partir daí o corpo para de acelerar. Na posição de barriga pra baixo, um paraquedista normalmente cai nessa velocidade. 🌬️

Antes do Luke, o Travis Pastrana já tinha feito o salto de 2007 que aparece no começo do vídeo. Ele é piloto de motocross e rali e cofundador do grupo de esportes radicais Nitro Circus, famoso por manobras como o primeiro duplo mortal de moto em competição, nos X Games de 2006. 🏍️

Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. candidates.creator: Julie B
candidates.title: The difference in my toddler when lask him if he's okay after he falls... vs when I don't…
candidates.description:
Now this isn’t foolproof because obviously if your toddler is actually hurt, they will cry. But often times they’re looking to us to figure out how they should react to a situation.

If they take a little tumble and we immediately gasp, rush over, and ask “ARE YOU OKAY?!” it can sometimes turn a moment they were ready to brush off into a much bigger reaction. Often times the fall just scares them and if we just act cool they’ll realize it wasn’t something that scary.

Sometimes the best thing we can do is pause, give them a second to process what happened, and let them decide how they feel before we react for them.

That doesn’t mean ignoring them or dismissing their feelings. It just means not automatically making every little bump or fall into a big deal.

I try to stay calm, observe, and let my toddler show me what he needs rather than assuming he needs to be upset.

What do you say or do when your toddler takes a tumble?! 

#toddlerlife #baby #toddlermom #motherhood #parenting

The Mirage is a family of jet aircraft designed by the French aerospace company Dassault Aviation. Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. The Mirage 2000, for instance, introduced fly-by-wire technology and advanced radar systems, making it a formidable multi-role fighter capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. The Mirage legacy continues to be celebrated for its contribution to both military aviation and aeronautical engineering.

When Efren Ramirez stepped into the role of Pedro Sanchez in the 2004 independent comedy Napoleon Dynamite, few involved in the low-budget production could have predicted the cultural phenomenon it would become. Filmed on a modest budget of roughly $400,000 in the small town of Preston, Idaho, the project relied on deadpan delivery and awkward silences, a comedic style that demanded remarkable restraint from its cast. Ramirez, whose stoic portrayal of the soft-spoken transfer student became one of the film's most beloved elements, later reflected on how difficult it had been to maintain that composure on set, and he singled out the moment that had pushed him closest to breaking character with laughter. His recollection offered fans a rare glimpse behind the film's carefully calibrated awkwardness, revealing that the actors themselves had often struggled to contain their amusement at the absurdity unfolding around them. Such anecdotes underscored how director Jared Hess's unconventional vision had succeeded precisely because the performers committed fully to its strange sincerity, transforming a quirky festival entry into an enduring touchstone of early-2000s American comedy whose quotable lines and offbeat characters continued to resonate with audiences for decades afterward.

candidates.creator: Pian Chow
candidates.title: No Nails, No Glue: Leonardo’s 9-Stick Bridge That Gets Stronger With Weight!
candidates.description:
This ancient engineering marvel was designed by Leonardo da Vinci over 500 years ago using just nine pieces of wood.

No nails. No screws. No ropes. No glue. No tools.

Each piece interlocks with the others through pure pressure, compression, and friction. The structure holds itself together and actually becomes stronger the more weight you place on it. Remove even a single piece and the entire bridge collapses — a deliberate feature Leonardo intended for military use.

Originally sketched in the Codex Atlanticus while Leonardo worked as a military engineer for Cesare Borgia, this self-supporting “emergency bridge” was meant to be assembled in minutes so troops could cross rivers quickly… and then dismantled just as fast to stop the enemy from following.

In this video you’ll see:

    How the 9 pieces lock together step by step
    The simple physics of compression and friction that make it work
    Why adding weight tightens the structure instead of breaking it
    A quick, satisfying build you can try at home with sticks, dowels, or even craft sticks

500 years later, Leonardo’s design still feels like magic — simple, elegant, and pure genius.

Try building your own and tell me how much weight it holds!

candidates.creator: OptimalHealth
candidates.title: How Household Conflict Impacts Children
candidates.description:
🧠 Can a single aggressive interaction change how a child behaves? In this fascinating psychology experiment, a young child is happily playing with a friendly adult—until another woman enters the room and begins speaking aggressively toward her.

What happens next reveals something important about child psychology, emotional safety, and the effects of witnessing conflict between adults.

👶 The Child's Reaction: After witnessing the hostile interaction, the child becomes hesitant and appears reluctant to continue playing with the previously friendly woman.

⚡ Emotional Safety: Children are highly sensitive to facial expressions, tone of voice, and emotional tension. Even when aggression isn't directed at them, they may respond to conflict happening around them.

🧠 The Psychology Behind It: Research suggests that witnessing hostility between adults can influence children's emotional responses, sense of security, and willingness to engage socially.

🏠 Household Conflict: Repeated exposure to intense or unresolved conflict at home may contribute to stress, anxiety, and behavioral difficulties in children.

Could children be absorbing more emotional tension than adults realize? This experiment highlights how quickly a child's behavior can change after witnessing an uncomfortable social interaction.

⚠️ Important: This clip illustrates an immediate behavioral response in a controlled interaction. It does not prove that a single argument causes lasting psychological harm. The frequency, intensity, and resolution of conflict all matter.

A dark house, a hairy arm through a cracked door, and five giant candy straws. The story did not add up.

candidates.title: They went to the beach and ended up saving a giant sea turtle 👏
candidates.description:
A giant sea turtle rescue unfolded on a remote beach in Isla Mujeres, Mexico, after four friends discovered an exhausted sea turtle trapped between rocks and unable to reach the ocean. At first, they weren’t even sure the turtle was still alive.

The stranded sea turtle had been out of the water for a long time and was too weak to free herself. With no cell signal and no immediate help available, the group worked together to carefully move the massive turtle toward the sea.

The rescue wasn’t easy. Because of her size and poor condition, they had to move her little by little, stopping along the way so she could rest. As waves began reaching her, the turtle slowly started showing more signs of life and renewed strength.

But even after making it back into the water, she still had to get past the rocks.

The friends followed her into the ocean, staying close until they could see that she was able to swim safely on her own.

After around 15 to 20 minutes, the exhausted sea turtle was finally swimming freely again.

This incredible wildlife rescue shows how a few determined people can make a huge difference for an animal in distress ❤️

Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. The Mirage 2000, for instance, introduced fly-by-wire technology and advanced radar systems, making it a formidable multi-role fighter capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. The Mirage legacy continues to be celebrated for its contribution to both military aviation and aeronautical engineering.

candidates.description:
About seven minutes before touchdown, the Apollo 11 lunar module computer threw a 1202 alarm: it had more work than time. Twenty-six-year-old guidance officer Steve Bales, backed by Jack Garman and his handwritten alarm list, called GO. The overload came from the rendezvous radar, switched on in case of an abort, which flooded the computer with junk signals. The guidance computer had 2,048 words of erasable memory (about 4 KB) and 36,864 words of read-only memory.

Would you have said go, or abort? Tell us in the comments.

candidates.title: Unnamed Life, 4km Down, Under 1979 Scars #Shorts
candidates.description:
Four kilometres of water is close to half the height of Mount Everest, and all of it is resting on one small animal.

New deep-sea species discovered in 2026 are being photographed for minutes at a time in the Clarion-Clipperton Zone, a dark abyssal plain in the Pacific larger than India. This video follows a single beam of light into the black, where a 1979 test-mining track still scars the seabed and roughly 90% of the recorded animals have no scientific name yet. We look at the cold, the pressure, the nodules that grow millimetres per million years, and what is lost when the lights switch off.

Timestamps:
0:00 Hook
1:00 The Weight of the Water
2:30 Where the Light Ends
4:30 The 1979 Furrow
7:00 The Names We Haven't Given

What does it take to cast your vote when you are 400 kilometres above Earth? As millions of Americans head to the polls for the crucial 2026 US midterm elections, NASA astronaut Anil Menon has taken part in the democratic process from an extraordinary location – the International Space Station.

Orbiting Earth aboard the ISS, Menon revealed that he completed an electronic ballot on his computer and transmitted it to election officials in Harris County, Texas. He also said that all three American crew members aboard the space station had the opportunity to exercise their right to vote.

candidates.description:
aOn February 18, 2021, NASA's Perseverance rover hit the top of Mars's atmosphere at nearly 12,500 mph and had about seven minutes to come to a dead stop on the ground. With radio signals taking more than 11 minutes to reach Earth, nobody at mission control could step in.

Here's how it did it, step by step: a heat shield that reached about 2,370°F, a 70-foot supersonic parachute, a camera that matched the ground to a stored map and picked its own safe spot, eight rocket engines, and the sky crane that lowered the rover on cables about 21 feet long.

The onboard footage in this video is real: it was shot by Perseverance's own cameras during the landing.

candidates.creator: Dusty Mammoth
candidates.title: This 4-Pound Helicopter Flew on Mars. 72 Times.
candidates.description:
In 2021, a 4-pound helicopter named Ingenuity did something no aircraft had ever done: it flew on another planet. The air on Mars is about 1% as dense as Earth's, every command took minutes to arrive, and nights dropped to −130°F. NASA planned five test flights. It flew 72 times.

Key facts (NASA/JPL):
• First powered, controlled flight on another planet — April 19, 2021, Jezero Crater
• Rotors spin at roughly 2,400 rpm
• 72 flights, 128.8 minutes in the air, 10.5 miles covered, max altitude 78.7 ft
• Flew more than 14 times farther than planned
• Final flight: Jan. 18, 2024 — a rotor blade was damaged on landing

Footage & images: NASA/JPL-Caltech, NASA/JPL-Caltech/ASU/MSSS (Mastcam-Z). Clips labeled "REAL FOOTAGE" were captured on Mars; clips labeled "NASA ANIMATION" are NASA renderings.

🐻 Медведи неожиданно появляются возле домов, забираются в автомобили и даже устраивают себе купание в джакузи

🐆 Леопарды пугают людей, гориллы знакомятся с туристами, а гепарды ведут себя совершенно непредсказуемо

🐘 Огромные слоны подходят к отдыхающим, преследуют автомобили и демонстрируют свой непростой характер

🐍 Гигантские питоны, анаконды и змеи, которые неожиданно появляются в человеческих жилищах

🦈 Акулы, мурены и другие морские хищники в невероятных подводных встречах

🦏 Носороги, бегемоты и буйволы устраивают настоящие противостояния и заставляют туристов поволноваться

🐒 Наглые обезьяны, любопытные шимпанзе и необычные встречи с семействами горилл

🦓 Зебры, жирафы, лоси и другие удивительные животные в самых неожиданных местах

🐕 Забавные собаки, любопытные птицы и милые моменты, которые обязательно поднимут настроение

Вас ждут невероятные столкновения, удивительные проявления животного интеллекта, неожиданные спасения и моменты, которые ещё раз доказывают, насколько разнообразен и непредсказуем мир дикой природы!

👇 Друзья, какая встреча с животными удивила вас больше всего? А может, вам самим приходилось сталкиваться с дикими животными? Обязательно поделитесь своими историями в комментариях!

candidates.title: How NASA Landed Perseverance Rover on Mars in 7 Minutes
candidates.description:
Nearly 20,000 km/h. A supersonic parachute. A rocket-powered sky crane. NASA’s Perseverance rover had around seven minutes to reach the surface of Mars.

On February 18, 2021, Perseverance landed in Jezero Crater after a descent that ended with the rover being lowered on three cables. Once its six wheels touched down, the cables were cut and the rocket stage flew away.

Its mission was only beginning. Jezero once held a lake, making it a promising place to search for signs of ancient microbial life. Perseverance studies the rocks, drills cores and seals samples for future analysis.

In 2025, scientists reported a potential biosignature in a rock called Cheyava Falls. Nonliving chemical processes could also explain the finding, so its origin remains under investigation.

By October 11, 2026, Perseverance had travelled 45.22 kilometres, breaking the record for driving on another world. NASA has approved continued exploration of Jezero’s rim through roughly the end of 2028.

This video uses AI-generated reconstructions based on NASA/JPL-Caltech imagery and mission information. Original NASA photographs are included where indicated. Mission information checked November 4, 2026.

The first sunset you see on Mars is blue, under a Sun two-thirds the size of ours. Outside, the air is too thin to keep your blood from boiling, and the dust carries a salt that poisons the thyroid. So why do the people who study a first year there most closely call it a death trap?

Over six hundred and sixty-eight sols, we live through it all: the frozen sky, the brown noon of a global dust storm, and one date engineers circled on their calendar.

Get comfortable and let this long year on the Martian plains keep you company tonight. Subscribe to Space After Midnight if you like falling asleep somewhere far from Earth.

candidates.title: Your PS5 Controller Can Remember Four Devices
candidates.description:
Since a PS5 system update in September 2025, the DualSense and DualSense Edge can remember four devices instead of one, and the four shape buttons are the slots: triangle is slot one, circle is two, cross is three and square is four. To add a PC, Mac, phone, tablet or Apple TV, unplug any USB cable and turn the controller off, then hold the PS button and a shape button for about five seconds until the lights flash twice, and pair it from that device’s Bluetooth settings. Your PS5 doesn’t need the combo, because pairing the controller with the console the usual way puts it in the next open slot by itself. To switch, turn on the device you want and hold the same two buttons for about three seconds. It works whether the controller is on or off, and the lights under the touchpad show which slot you’ve landed on. Before this, playing on a PC meant pairing the controller all over again, then pairing it back to the console afterwards. If all four slots are in use, pairing a new device replaces whichever one you haven’t connected to for the longest.

🔴 Perseverance Makes History on Mars
On February 18, 2021, NASA's Perseverance rover successfully achieved a historic, completely autonomous landing on the dusty surface of Mars. Because radio signals take over 11 minutes to travel the vast distance between Mars and Earth, real-time human control from mission control was completely impossible. 🚀 Conquering the Seven Minutes of Terror

candidates.title: A Rover Filmed Its Own Mars Landing 🪂

This is real footage of NASA's Perseverance rover landing in Jezero Crater on Mars on February 18, 2021, recorded by its own entry, descent and landing cameras: cameras looking up at the parachute, one looking down from the descent stage, one on the rover looking up, and one on the rover's belly looking at the ground. The 70.5-foot (21.5-meter) supersonic parachute opened about 7 miles above the surface while the spacecraft was moving about 940 mph (1,512 km/h). After the heat shield fell away, the rocket-powered descent stage lowered the rover on cables about 21 feet (6.4 meters) long, the "sky crane" maneuver, then flew off to crash a safe distance away. The parachute's orange and white pattern spells JPL's motto, "Dare Mighty Things," in binary, one word per ring, with the GPS coordinates of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory around the outer edge. Radio signals took about 11 minutes to travel from Mars to Earth that day, so the rover had already landed by the time mission control heard the parachute had opened.

candidates.description:
[지금 이 시간 가장 뜨거운 뉴스를 '콕' 찍어 전해드립니다]

도널드 트럼프 대통령에 대한 중간평가라고도 할 수 있는 미국 중간선거가 현지시간 3일 미 전역에서 치러졌는데요.

그런데, 특별한 곳에서도 소중한 한 표가 행사됐습니다.

▶ 인터뷰 : 아닐 메논 / NASA 소속 비행사
- "우주정거장에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 오늘 이곳에서 투표할 수 있는 특권을 누리게 됐습니다."

국제우주정거장, ISS에 체류 중인 미국 항공우주 NASA 소속 비행사 아닐 메논도 전자 투표를 마쳤습니다.

▶ 인터뷰 : 아닐 메논 / NASA 소속 비행사
- "여기가 제 방인데, 저에게는 투표소 역할도 하는 공간입니다."

임시 투표소로 변신한 곳은 다름 아닌 메논의 개인 침실이었습니다.

▶ 인터뷰 : 아닐 메논 / NASA 소속 비행사
"저는 방 안에 있는 컴퓨터로 전자투표용지를 작성해 해리스 카운티에 전송할 수 있었습니다. 그렇게 오늘 투표를 마쳤습니다."

메논을 비롯해 ISS에 체류 중인 NASA 소속 비행사 3명이 전자 투표를 마쳤습니다.

이들이 작성한 전자 투표용지는 여러 단계를 거쳐 지상으로 전달됩니다.

먼저 암호화된 상태로 NASA의 근지구 네트워크를 통해 뉴멕시코 지상 안테나로 전달됩니다.

이후 휴스턴 제어센터를 거쳐 텍사스주 해리스 카운티로 최종 전송되는 방식입니다.

한편, 트럼프 대통령의 남은 2년 임기의 운명을 가를 중간선거 결과는 한국시간으로 이르면 오늘 오후부터 윤곽이 드러날 것으로 예상됩니다.

일부 주에서는 이미 투표가 마감됐고, 순차적으로 개표가 진행됩니다.

현지에서는 트럼프 행정부에 대한 심판을 바라는 이른바 '앵그리 트럼프' 유권자들과, 

여론조사에선 드러나지 않다가 투표장에서 지지를 보내는 '샤이 트럼프'의 결집이 주요 변수가 될 것으로 보고 있습니다.
